A shield in the search bar (the header on the Dev tab) shows the state at a glance: a crossed shield while verification is on, a checked one once Orion turned it off. Tap it any time to secure the phone, or to revert everything in one tap. Hide it with Protection shield in Orion Xtra.
Active downloads, ready installs and pending updates in a compact sheet over whatever you are doing, with Install all or Update all. While something downloads, a progress ring in the header opens it.
Any app, straight from its source, installed and updated by Orion.
Apps hosted on GitHub show their star count right under the developer name.

Before each root or Shizuku install, or on the APK installer sheet also over wireless debugging, pick from 19 options: downgrade, grant all permissions, restricted settings, test builds, storage location, Play Store or a custom installer and more.

Beyond install has its own switch on the APK installer sheet, through root, Shizuku or wireless debugging. Switches the APK needs, like Allow downgrade for an older version or Bypass target SDK block for an old app, are picked for you and marked Needed.
Bring your Obtainium export file, JSON or obtainium:// links over, and take your Orbit back out in Obtainium\'s format. Add to Obtainium links open in Orion too.
Built-in wireless debugging installs apps instantly as the shell user, set up once with a few guided steps. Orion turns Wireless debugging back on by itself when it is off.
Developer, size, package name and source, folded away until you want them.
Earn 10 XP for each app in your library, 100 for each app you submit, 40 for each Fuel the Code mission, 150 for each collection badge, plus mini game XP.
Every recent release of an Orbit app shows in its version picker, so going back to an older build is one tap.

Give an Orbit app tags in Fine-tune. All, Sources, Tags and the i button sit in one row. Sources and Tags open a box where you can pick more than one, then tap Done. The i button lists every link Orbit can read.
Hide the status bar while Orion is open, or keep it showing. Swipe down from the top to peek it.
Hold an Orbit app on the version it has from its long-press menu.
Let Orion install the updates it downloads, whether it is open or closed. Anything that cannot finish is reported the next time you open the app.
Long-press an installed app in My Apps to start picking, tap more (or All), then Uninstall. Silent with root, Shizuku or Dhizuku, one system prompt each otherwise.

Long-press an Orbit app and share it: it opens a ready submission so everyone can find the app, and it counts as a contribution with XP. After every five apps you add, Orion asks again. That reminder stays until you tap Share one or Later.
Modded builds list every patch applied to them in one folding row.

News from the Orion team drops from a megaphone next to Settings in the header. It pulses until you tap Got it, then leaves until a new announcement arrives. The last one stays readable from the megaphone at the top of Settings. It pulses until you have read it.
On tablets, foldables, TVs and wide split screens, keep the side rail or move the dock to the bottom or top. Phones always keep the dock at the bottom.
Orbit apps install, update and auto-update like store apps, with every install route Orion has: root, Shizuku, Dhizuku and wireless debugging.

Orion is an installer too: open an APK, XAPK, APKM, APKS or a zip of APKs in your file manager or browser and pick Install with Orion, or use Install an APK file in Settings. A bundle is opened by the APKs inside it, even when the file itself is not an APK. A sheet shows the app, its version and what is installed, can scan the file with your VirusTotal key, and installs through root, Shizuku, Dhizuku or wireless debugging, skipping the 24-hour wait. Split bundles keep only the pieces that match this phone.

Orion runs on Android TV: it opens on the TV catalog, installs TV apps right on the TV, and every card lights up as your remote moves. Tap the TV Beta pill to report a bug. Downloads that stall on a server switch to a plain connection by themselves.

Paste a GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, SourceHut, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, Uptodown, APKMirror, APKPure, Aptoide, itch.io, Farsroid, LiteAPKs, APK4Free, CoolApk, SourceForge, Jenkins, Telegram or Discord link, a direct APK, XAPK or APKM link, or any web page that offers them. Orion reads its name, icon, description, screenshots and releases.
Pick Stable, Beta, Alpha or Nightly per app, or choose an exact older version. Install a Beta or Nightly and its updates follow that channel, so it no longer shows the Stable build as an update.
Pick which APK counts with a file name filter, include pre-releases, read the version out of the tag with a pattern, and set the icon and screenshots yourself.
Pill, Classic, Icons, Labeled, Expressive and Shape shift. Expressive and Shape shift unlock with Fuel the Code ads.
Remove an installed app from its page or from My Apps without leaving Orion. Silent with root, Shizuku or Dhizuku.
Remove preinstalled system apps reversibly, guided by a community list that marks what is safe to cut. Each app\'s notes come with tappable links and sources.
ReVanced apps and Metrolist are not allowed in Orbit, because Orbit can\'t maintain them. Follow Morphe instead of ReVanced, and ArchiveTune or BiTChord instead of Metrolist.
Scale the dock between compact and large with a live preview. It starts compact.
Share a short web link (rookieenough.github.io/Orion-Data/app/?id=...) that opens the app in Orion, a deep link, or a Markdown or HTML badge for your README.
Silent installs, updates and uninstalls through Dhizuku\'s shared device owner, with no Shizuku or root. Android 8 and up.
Six launcher icons beyond the classic one. Neon and Gold unlock with Fuel the Code ads: tap one, then every ad you watch counts toward it.

Suggest an app from GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg. Orion detects its name, package, description, category, icon and screenshots (from store metadata or the README), accepts Obtainium exports and opens a ready GitHub issue.

Tap Inspect in the stats row to see trackers, permissions, libraries, compatibility and the signature before you install. When Orion has to download the build to read it, that same file stays, so Install uses it instead of downloading again.
Tap Make in the palette row, pick a primary color plus optional secondary and tertiary ones, choose Soft, Balanced or Vivid and preview it in every theme. Long-press your palette to edit it.

Tap the developer coin on the Dev tab, then tap it again to open the global leaderboard. Claim your own rank once you have five contributions; after that your entry refreshes itself when you level up.

Tap the star and describe what you need, like a free music app. Use your own Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude key, or a model that runs on the phone. Import a LiteRT model from this phone, or paste a Hugging Face link to one. Drag the star anywhere.

The APK installer sheet reads the file before it installs: the framework it was built with (Flutter, React Native, Unity, Compose and more), its processor support and whether it runs on this phone, 16 KB page readiness, trackers found in its code, permissions with the ones an update adds marked New, components, SDK levels, native libraries, where the size goes and the signing key. Tap the card for the full page. Everything is read offline.
The catalog loads from GitHub, JSDelivr or GitHack, whichever answers, even when your network or DNS blocks GitHub, and stays cached for offline use.
The first time you open Orbit, you can hide it if you only want Orion\'s own apps. Turn it back on under Settings, Interface, Navigation tabs.
The Obtainium apps directory lives inside Orbit: search hundreds of ready-made configs and add one in a tap.
The release notes of the version you would download, folded into one row below About. The row shows right away and the notes load in the background, also when an update is waiting.

Tokens on the Orbit tab let GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg answer private repos and skip the public rate limit. Each field links to the page that creates that token. The GitHub token is the same one in Developer tools, so a token you already saved is used.
Two charts after the bundles rank apps by their GitHub stars: the most starred, and the least starred ones worth a look. Stars come with the catalog, so they cost no GitHub requests.
Unlock both locked icons for Icon Collector and both locked docks for Dock Master.
When an app\'s repo is a fork, Source and safety names the original project and its stars, one tap away.

When Android switches on its developer verification component, which can slow down or block sideloaded apps, Orion offers Secure me: one tap turns it off through root, Shizuku or wireless debugging. Without any of those, the popup walks you through the wireless debugging setup and comes back to finish. Orion checks the phone afterwards and tells you exactly why if Android refused.
